lesson_text: runserver always runs the full system checks in inner_run() via self.check(display_num_errors=True) before serving; there is no --skip-checks option on runserver, so to skip checks you have to call the command with requires_system_checks disabled in a subclass.

Model._check_default_pk() in django/db/models/base.py raises models.W042 whenever cls._meta.pk.auto_created is true and DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD is not overridden; it does not special-case the parent_link OneToOneField that multi-table inheritance creates, so child models of a parent with an explicit primary key still get the warning.

ModelChoiceField.to_python() raises ValidationError with code 'invalid_choice' but passes no params, so a custom invalid_choice message that uses %(value)s cannot show the rejected value. ModelMultipleChoiceField does pass value in params.

Q._combine() in django/db/models/query_utils.py raises TypeError(other) for anything that is not a Q instance, so Q(...) & Exists(...) fails while Exists(...) & Q(...) works. Wrap the Exists in Q() when it must come second.

HashedFilesMixin.post_process() in django/contrib/staticfiles/storage.py yields every adjustable file once per pass (first pass plus up to max_post_process_passes), so collectstatic counts and reports the same CSS file several times. Deduplicate by original name if you consume post_process() output.
django.utils.datastructures.OrderedSet keeps insertion order in an internal dict but defines no __reversed__, so reversed(OrderedSet(...)) raises TypeError. Use reversed(list(ordered_set)) instead.

SQLCompiler.get_group_by() adds the columns of every non-reference ORDER BY expression to GROUP BY, including fields that come only from Meta.ordering, so an aggregate over a model with Meta.ordering groups by the ordering field and returns wrong counts. Clear ordering with order_by() before values().annotate().

ResolverMatch.__repr__() in django/urls/resolvers.py formats func with _func_path, which for a functools.partial view is just 'functools.partial', and formats args and kwargs with %s rather than %r. Do not rely on repr(resolver_match) to identify partial views.

AutoFieldMeta.__subclasscheck__ only checks 'subclass in self._subclasses', so issubclass(MyBigAutoField, AutoField) is False for a user subclass of BigAutoField, and DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD pointing at such a subclass fails with 'must subclass AutoField'.

The PostgreSQL DatabaseClient.settings_to_cmd_args_env() returns an empty dict for env when no PG* settings are configured, and BaseDatabaseClient.runshell() then passes env={} to subprocess.run, so the psql subprocess does not inherit os.environ. Expect PGPASSWORD from the shell to be ignored by dbshell.

URLValidator in django/core/validators.py has no check for tab, CR or LF characters of its own; whether 'http://www.djangoproject.com/\n' is rejected depends on the Python version, because newer urllib.parse.urlsplit strips those characters (bpo-43882).

DateFormat.Y() in django/utils/dateformat.py returns self.data.year as an int, not a zero-padded string, so dateformat.format(date(1, 1, 1), 'Y') gives '1' rather than '0001'. Pad it yourself when years below 1000 matter.
